answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the zephyr graph. Re-attestations are stored in oasis and ferrous lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 17 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 133 impostors cost 1431 times the honest price and take 3 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
